name: claude-tools
description: Skills for Claude Code: prompting Fable, an image looker, a Fable advisor and a Haiku worker for mechanical jobs.

plugins.name: fable-prompting
plugins.description: Prompting techniques for Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5: effort levels, symptom-to-fix snippets and task scoping.

plugins.name: look
plugins.description: Separate model runs look at screenshots and rate them against your aims, so the agent judges a visual result without reading the image itself.

plugins.name: advisor
plugins.description: A separate read-only Fable run decides a design or implementation question in the person's place and returns one choice with its reason.

plugins.name: haiku-worker
plugins.description: A background Haiku subagent does one mechanical job, such as a search, a test run or an edit to a written spec, and returns only its result, so the main agent keeps its context and every judgment.
